constraints.description: Generated artifacts must be synchronized deterministically before parent certification, commit, or push.

validation.validation_method: Require two byte-identical distribution runs, current generated-output validation, and repository-owned install parity.

constraints.description: No committed API key, token, password, or private key may be introduced.

validation.validation_method: Scan added diff lines for recognized credential and private-key patterns without printing candidate values.

constraints.description: Codex and operator documentation must describe the daemon-free default and explicit sharing profile.

validation.validation_method: Inspect docs/codex-plugin.md, the CLAUDE.md Codex section, public installation guides, and generated documentation sync.

constraints.description: Distribution generation must remain byte-idempotent and generated plugin surfaces must not be hand-edited.

validation.validation_method: Require matching aggregate hashes over path, mode, and bytes from two repository-owned generation passes.

constraints.description: Modified macOS shell entrypoints must remain compatible with /bin/bash and avoid unsupported Bash 4-only constructs on launchd paths.

validation.validation_method: Run /bin/bash syntax checks and inspect modified service paths for mapfile or associative arrays.

constraints.description: A projection-semantics upgrade must invalidate revision-only freshness markers and replay derived files without mutating signed authority.

validation.validation_method: Require projectionContractVersion 2, a projection-only repair with identical source/result revision, and terminal 10/10 task output with no pending cancelled task.

constraints.description: Compatibility evidence is preserved outside live discovery; generated and installed surfaces agree; memory, registry, and signed local KBD behavior are certified without an always-on control plane.

validation.validation_method: Validate all reconciliation receipts and require current daemon-free launchd/process state plus completed signed task boundaries.

global_rules: Use only local full-integration and contract evidence
Keep sovereign-sync stopped unless sharing is explicitly requested
termination_conditions: Every reconciliation receipt parses and proves its claimed boundary
Projection-contract replay preserves the canonical revision and removes contradictory pending work
The QA report exists and the artifact manifest validates
